nodes.text: Theophrastus, in his Ethics, having raised the question whether characters turn with fortunes and, moved by the sufferings of bodies, depart from virtue, has recorded that Pericles, when he was ill, showed one of his friends who came to visit him an amulet that the women had hung around his neck, as if to say that he was in a very bad way indeed, when he would put up even with this foolishness.
